note: Each quoted PROJECTION line from the mapfile is returned as an MS_STRING token with its input-controlled text in msyystring_buffer.
The input PROJECTION block causes the map projection object to be passed into loadProjection for parsing.
The parser accepts another projection argument without enforcing that i remains below the MS_MAXPROJARGS capacity of p->args.
On the twenty-first projection string, i equals MS_MAXPROJARGS and this assignment writes one pointer past the allocated p->args array.
The loop counter is incremented after each accepted argument, allowing repeated input strings to advance i to the overflowing index.
